title: Go Away Big Green Monster
author: Ed Emberley

hero.name: Big Green Monster
hero.description: A scary green monster face built up and taken apart page by page, with yellow eyes, blue nose, white teeth, and scraggly orange hair — Ed Emberley's distinctive die-cut character
hero.source_note: Distinctive Emberley character — source from Creative Fabrica, TPT, or Teachers Pay Teachers clip art; generic Boardmaker monster unlikely to match

ambiguous.issue: Could show human hair, animal fur, or monster scraggly hair
ambiguous.reason: Monster's scraggly orange hair is a key recurring feature of the book; generic hair symbol is acceptable

notes: This book is built around naming and dismissing monster body parts — face, eyes, teeth, and hair are the core vocabulary alongside the colours green, yellow, and orange which are explicitly named on each page. 'Away' and 'come back' mirror the two-part structure of the book (building the monster then sending it away). 'Scary' supports emotional response vocabulary. The hero image must show the distinctive Emberley monster face; a generic Boardmaker monster will not be recognisable to students familiar with the book cover. Consider adding a nose symbol if a 13th slot were available (blue nose is named in the book), but within 11 fringe words the selections above cover the highest-frequency and most communicatively useful terms.

matching.note: Min 4 approved stems, no hard cap

cvc_decode.note: 3-5 groups x 3 CVC words (phonics, not theme icons)
